name: 目标客户
description: One row per target account with fit evidence, pain signals, a reviewed first-touch draft, and outreach state

agentPrompts.label: What's in my outreach queue?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder, then show me the target accounts grouped by status (needs review / to-send / sent / opted-out), with match score, match reason, and pain signals for each.

agentPrompts.label: Draft or refine a first-touch email
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then draft or refine the first-touch email subject/body for the company I name, grounded only in stored offer claims and this company's observed signals — never invent urgency, customer logos, metrics, or relationships.

agentPrompts.label: Approve a company's first touch
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then approve the first-touch draft for the company I name, moving it to `queued`. This only queues it — the trusted sender still has to run `send_emails.mjs --apply` to actually send it.

agentPrompts.label: Mark a company opted out
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-sales-outreach` skill in this folder, then mark the company I name `opted-out` immediately. This is terminal — never queue or send to this company again.
